reviewed_contracts.identity_schema: Finite plain JSON, nonempty dict identities, strict bool/int/float representation,64KiB derived identity bounds,64-level recursion guard, duplicate JSON-key and nonfinite-token rejection. Fixed source-seal inventory keys/presence/bytes/hash schemas are strict.
reviewed_contracts.bounded_filesystem_reads: Regular artifact/ancestor symlink,junction,reparse rejection; fixed filenames;1MiB file hashing chunks; bounded marker and media-metadata reads check size before full read and retained descriptor/path signatures afterward. Required normalized files must be nonempty.
reviewed_contracts.exclusive_publication: Already-present source marker is rejected. File contents are synced and re-inventoried before an exclusive hard-link marker publication; staging is retained. Source-marker loading never normalizes or rewrites these assets.
reviewed_contracts.presence_matching: Both optional normalized files encode explicit absence or exact presence/byte/hash records. A later added or removed file changes the derived identity and rejects load.
reviewed_contracts.prefix_and_ball_binding: Derived identity binds baseidentity and exact normalized inventory. Ball-journal identity additionally binds prefix-marker bytes, operation config and canonical resolved device. Full prefix validation is a separate owner used by validate_partial_inference; ball_journal_identity alone is not a full prefix validator.
reviewed_contracts.journal_recovery: Valid prefix with no journal/sidecars returns zero frontier without creating a journal. Existing journal opens read/write explicitly for SQLite hot rollback, then every accepted frame is read through its integrity/codec checks. No new frames are appended. Orphaned/redirected sidecars are rejected.
reviewed_contracts.tamper_recheck: After journal validation, normalized asset/source-marker bindings and exact prefix-marker binding are rechecked; prefix metadata access verifies retained database signature. Changed mapping count is rejected against prefix count.
reviewed_contracts.exception_and_corruption: Present malformed seals raise; missing source/prefix returns None by API. Worker separately rejects retained-prefix/missing-source state, so it does not restart normalization over that corruption. File and directory cleanup retain original BaseException identities and annotate secondary close failures; prefix/journal owners provide their own cleanup handling.
